newsitem.title: USA: Ben & Jerry's sees lower Q3 results.
newsitem.headline: Ben & Jerry's sees lower Q3 results.

text.p: Ben & Jerry's Homemade Inc said on Monday that lower than expected sales volumes and higher dairy costs are expected to push third quarter results "materially below" $0.35 a share earned in the year ago period.
Analysts had expected the ice cream maker to earn $0.39 a share for the third quarter, according to First Call's consensus estimates.
Ben & Jerry shares traded at 13-1/4, off 1-1/8, on 23,800 shares of volume.
